claims.claim: Extended-statistics design changes the optimizer's information state and is therefore semantic physical design.
Selection has independent semantic and resource justifications.
claims.scope: Empirical non-monotonicity and measured recurring maintenance in Census and DMV.

claims.claim: CE-Replay supplies objective and dependency interfaces.
claims.scope: Validated executable fragment and supplied frozen realization.

claims.claim: No separate learned subset-to-q-error model is needed inside the faithfully replayed boundary.
claims.scope: Does not exclude learned or approximate components outside the boundary.

claims.claim: Execution-sufficient state need not be counterfactual-safe.
claims.scope: Presented as an observed design lesson, not a theorem.

claims.claim: Census supports local incremental evaluation but not useful connected-component or tested semantic-factor decomposition.
claims.scope: Census only; no universal decomposition claim.

claims.claim: Reduced semantic/control work does not guarantee wall-clock speedup.
claims.scope: Mixed implementation measured slower; MCV-only measured faster.

claims.claim: Topology determines incremental-evaluation opportunity, not correctness.
claims.scope: Two complementary workloads, not a scaling law.

claims.claim: Mechanism-weighted object count is a first-order environment-specific maintenance proxy.
claims.scope: Not a universal or per-candidate ANALYZE latency model.

claims.claim: Resource semantics can materially change the chosen design.
A locally optimal design may leave capacity unused.
claims.scope: Audited neighborhood local optimality, not global optimality.

claims.claim: Same-realization semantic fidelity is distinct from frozen-to-fresh payload drift.
claims.scope: DMV lacks full paired per-query drift provenance.

claims.claim: Repeated Census ANALYZE shows realization variability but not design-ranking instability or regret.
Candidate-payload acquisition is an offline boundary distinct from recurring deployed maintenance.
CE-Replay is deliberately extensible but not automatically extensible.
claims.scope: ScalarArray is one bounded demonstrated extension.

claims.claim: Mechanisms should be integrated as explicit state transitions when upstream consumption changes downstream applicability.
claims.scope: Derived from PostgreSQL MCV-to-FD; not asserted for all DBMS mechanisms.

risky_word_audit.exact: Used only for audited incremental evaluation or explicit native comparison boundaries; never full PostgreSQL CE.
risky_word_audit.optimal: Qualified as neighborhood local optimum; global only for small/restricted exhaustive audits.
risky_word_audit.general: Used for unsolved general payload acquisition or denied universal claims.
risky_word_audit.scalable: Not used as an affirmative claim.
risky_word_audit.robust: Used only for future objectives or to deny current realization robustness.
risky_word_audit.efficient: Used only as future payload-acquisition work, not a completed claim.
risky_word_audit.faithful: Bound to same realization and supported fragment.
risky_word_audit.native: Bound to PostgreSQL semantics and matched physical/payload realization.
risky_word_audit.replay: Defined as CE-Replay or semantic/control replay, never full planner replay.
risky_word_audit.workload-specialized: Used as the canonical architectural qualifier.
